title: Starblaster 3000
author: OkBlackberry4961
selftext:
Not sure if this will be allowed to share, I made this with ChatGPT and Grok, It's a retro feel and to test what is achievable with even just free versions of these tools. I added a global scoreboard, so if you get a high score leave your name or initials.

[https://www.stirlingcreative.com/games/starblaster3000/](https://www.stirlingcreative.com/games/starblaster3000/)

comments.author: OkBlackberry4961
comments.body: I already had this called "low quality junk" i'm just experimenting with what can be done with free versions of online AI tools.

replies.author: OkBlackberry4961
replies.body: Chat GPT to start it and then used Grok for maybe 70% of it.

replies.author: 99catgames
replies.body: Sorry, you said that in the post. Very nice!

replies.author: OkBlackberry4961
replies.body: Thanks man, far kinder than the comments I got earlier! lol

comments.author: Jindujun
comments.body:
That was a fun little game.

Reminds me of old arcade games, which I guess is the point.

But WOW the Atari2600 had much better graphics than I remember ;)

replies.author: OkBlackberry4961
replies.body: Hey man, thanks for the comment, yeah i had a little fun making an Atari mockup graphic.

comments.author: icekiller333
comments.body: The particles when you hit a ship are awesome :) Great job!

replies.author: OkBlackberry4961
replies.body: Thanks, originally they just disappeared and that addition of the particles really helped give it more life.
